loop_policy: TEST -> ERROR -> CORRECT -> INVALIDATE PASS -> RESTART

findings.finding: Legacy Master validator assumed exactly 42 active authority modules; V2.1 legitimately has 46.
findings.correction: Created V2.1 validator with 46-module contract plus Country/MAR/Kenua guards.

findings.finding: Bridge treated SocialMemorySystem.recall_memories() as a mapping instead of the list returned by the API.
findings.correction: Use list directly and count returned memories.

findings.finding: Witness selection treated _all_npc_records() values as tuples although it yields NPC dictionaries.
Ecology, Consequence and Atlas bridge retained hard-coded V2.0.1 hash checks and rejected verified Master V2.1.
findings.correction: LivingRuntime is the supported-baseline authority; dependent modules re-check the runtime-verified hash. Atlas bridge uses the shared supported-baseline registry.

findings.finding: V1.3 health gate read Master identity from top-level world fields instead of world.baseline.

findings.correction: Tests query the immutable event ledger contract directly.

findings.finding: A CHILD could buy a WPN item, equip it and initiate NPC combat although child hunting was already blocked.
findings.correction: Bridge blocks child weapon purchase, weapon equip and initiated combat before mutable domain actions.

findings.finding: V1.3 static auditor initially read wrong keys in Master V2.1 Country/MAR contracts.
findings.correction: Auditor now validates actual hierarchy, narrative_safety and weapons/count fields.

findings.finding: Test execution creates __pycache__ artifacts that must not ship.
findings.correction: Release pipeline cleans caches before the no-pycache gate and packaging.

findings.finding: Monolithic regression command can exceed executor window and obscure module-level progress.
findings.correction: Final regression is executed per test module in isolated processes/batches; consolidated evidence records 23/23 modules.

findings.finding: Seeded combat roll included fresh runtime UUIDs, so the same logical seeded scenario could diverge after clean restore/re-execution (observed bridge-stress witness-memory aggregate 161 vs 152).
findings.correction: Combat RNG now hashes world seed + deterministic event ordinal + logical entity identities + weapon ref + state versions; runtime UUIDs are excluded from the roll key. Added cross-instance determinism regression.

findings.finding: New determinism regression initially queried a non-public/non-existent commerce.catalog attribute after the scenario had completed.
findings.correction: Determinism test now reads catalog count from CommerceSystem.full_integrity_check(), the supported integrity API.

findings.finding: Rebuilt catalog/distribution stress initially instantiated CountryScale without SceneInteractionSystem, yielding a misleading 0 dungeon/scene-object coverage.
findings.correction: Stress harness now bootstraps SceneInteractionSystem before catalog/distribution inspection so dungeon and scene item references are actually covered.

findings.finding: Historical Stage14 release-readiness auditor compared V1.3/V1.1-evolved runtime modules against Stage13 V1.0 baseline hashes and reported five obsolete baseline mismatches despite clean functional Stage14 gates.
findings.correction: Historical auditor is preserved as evidence; new V1.3 release-readiness auditor validates Master V2.1 dependency, V1.3 mutation allowlist/static audit, deterministic combat evidence, current regression/stress reports, safety/hygiene and Stage13/14 reports.

findings.finding: New V1.3 readiness auditor initially expected Stage13 reports under a STAGE13 subdirectory, while the established Stage13 runners write them at 04_REPORTS root.
findings.correction: Readiness auditor now follows the actual Stage13 report paths and was restarted.
